preset_name: Girl Scouts troop (Girl Scouts of the USA)

about: Girl Scouts helps girls in kindergarten through 12th grade build courage, confidence, and character. Girl Scouts explore STEM, the outdoors, entrepreneurship, and life skills, and earn badges along the way.
Troops are girl-led: members choose activities, plan trips, run the cookie program, and take action in their community, with support from trained volunteers.

groups_intro: Girl Scouts are grouped by grade level. Some troops include several levels.

join_steps.title: Contact Us
join_steps.text: Email us with your Girl Scout's name and grade. We'll answer any questions.

join_steps.title: Visit a Meeting
join_steps.text: Come meet the troop and see what we do.

join_steps.title: Join Online
join_steps.text: Register through Girl Scouts of the USA and ask to be placed in our troop.

uniform: Girl Scouts wear a vest or sash for their level to display badges and pins. Ask us what your Girl Scout needs.

safety.title: Keeping Girls Safe
points: Every adult volunteer is screened and background-checked through our Girl Scout council.
At least two unrelated, approved adult volunteers are present at troop meetings and activities.
We follow Girl Scouts' Safety Activity Checkpoints, and post photos only with written permission from a parent or guardian, never with a girl's full name.

faq.q: When and where do you meet?
Can we visit before we join?
faq.a: Yes! Email {email} and we'll invite you to a meeting.

faq.q: What are the Girl Scout levels?
faq.a: Daisy (K–1), Brownie (2–3), Junior (4–5), Cadette (6–8), Senior (9–10), and Ambassador (11–12).
Yes, and we'd love the help. Volunteers are screened and trained through our Girl Scout council.
